title: Design System: Winter Dispatch / Зимняя доставка

display.purpose: The one large display voice, printed in signal red at 56px in 1200×750 card units.

headline.purpose: PREVIEW / ПРЕДПРОСМОТР and PNG dimension in the workbench.

title.purpose: Numbered control-panel headings in both languages.

body.purpose: Studio copy, buttons, inputs and textarea.

label.purpose: Field names, language switch, header meta and the stage-bar scene tag.

meta.purpose: Hints, counters, stamp names, status line and footer notes at the 12px functional-text floor.

card-address.purpose: Recipient and sender values printed in ice ink on the card.

shadows.name: card-frame
shadows.purpose: Deepest lift, under the previewed postcard; the ring is the 5% signal-red wash.

shadows.name: controls-rail
shadows.purpose: Softer lift under the whole composer stack.

shadows.name: primary-button
shadows.purpose: Shallow lift on the single action.

shadows.name: live-dot
shadows.purpose: 14% signal-red state ring on live dots, not elevation.

shadows.name: selected-stamp
shadows.purpose: 25% signal-red inset ring on the checked stamp tile.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Border, background and colour changes on stamp tiles, ghost button and download button.

motion.name: registration-sweep
motion.purpose: Signal-red sweep across the card frame on stamp change, sample load and language switch.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global override when prefers-reduced-motion is set; also suppresses the sweep entirely.

motion.name: scene-cycle
motion.purpose: Four authored winter scenes rotate automatically; any field edit clears and restarts the timer.

motion.name: scene-refresh-fade
motion.purpose: Short opacity and blur fade on scene change; skipped under reduced motion while the scene still changes.

components.name: Primary Download Button
components.description: The single signal-red action that saves the previewed canvas as a PNG.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined full-width button that loads an authored sample greeting in the active language.

components.name: Stamp Option
components.description: One of eight radio tiles in a 4×2 grid, with a 60×72px stamp thumbnail.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Raised, hairline-bordered text input with red text, red caret and a red focus state.

components.name: Message Field
components.description: Resizable bilingual greeting textarea with a 96px minimum height and 1.55 line step.

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Square header pill whose signal-red dot reports ready, synced, check or sent state in EN or RU.

components.name: Control Panel
components.description: Numbered composer section on the panel ground, divided from its neighbours by a hairline rule.

components.name: Postcard Artifact
components.description: Signature printed card: survey grid, one of four rotating moon-and-aurora scenes with snow, pines and lit cabins, red registration brackets, and no printed greeting caption.

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: Two-segment EN/RU control in the header; the active segment is a signal-red block with dark ink.

components.name: Skip Link
components.description: Signal-red skip link with dark ink, revealed on focus at the top-left of the viewport.

narrative.overview:
Winter Dispatch is an operator desk for sending a winter greeting, not a scrapbook. The studio is a near-black blue-charcoal instrument panel: dense monospaced type at small sizes, hairline rules, squared corners, and one red voice. Signal red is the primary font, the accent, the selection and focus ink, the live status and the single download action; pale ice ink carries the secondary hierarchy. The header holds the product name, an EN/RU switch and a sync state; the workbench holds a card and its controls; a status line confirms every edit.

The card is a separate material. It keeps its own darker paper, a 30px survey grid, a fine printed border with red corner registration brackets, and one of four authored moon-and-aurora winter scenes that rotate every seven seconds — each with its own moon, arcs, snow, pines and cabins. Eight authored stamp designs and an address block sit in the same monospace voice. The greeting is the one large display voice, printed in signal red; the card prints no GREETING caption of its own. The EN/RU switch translates the studio and the card's masthead, printed labels, stamp text and status words together, and the choice survives a reload. Because the preview is drawn directly into the canvas that downloads, warmth lives in the artifact while the studio stays legible and quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black blue-charcoal ground, signal-red primary font and accent, ice-white secondary ink, deep-red stamp artwork, amber warning ink.
One mono family in both English and Russian, with Segoe UI in the stack for Cyrillic; hierarchy comes from size, weight and tracking, and the chosen language survives a reload.
Hairline rules, square corners, a 2px radius only on text fields, and a 6/8/12/18/28px spacing rhythm.
Two-panel workbench with the 360px rail on the right, eight 60×72px stamp previews in a 4×2 grid, and a live 2× canvas preview that is exactly the PNG.
The printed card has its own paper, grid, stamp block, red registration marks and localized inscriptions; one of four authored scenes rotates every seven seconds and the stage bar names it.

rules.name: The State Ink Rule
rules.body: Signal red carries the primary voice, selection, focus, caret, live status and the single download action; deep red belongs to printed stamp art; amber appears only in warning status. Ice ink is a hierarchy tone, never an accent.

rules.name: The Readable Label Rule
rules.body: Every label pair clears 4.5:1; the shipped verifier reports 17/17 pairs with a 4.76:1 floor (deep stamp red on pale paper). Signal red measures 6.14–7.03:1 on the dark surfaces. Atmosphere never buys a contrast exception.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: One monospace family carries display, body, labels and print in both languages; contrast comes from scale, weight and tracking, never from introducing a second typeface.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by wide, faint shadow and hairline rule; the card sits deepest, the rail next, the button shallowest.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Panels, tiles, buttons and the language switch are square; the 2px radius belongs only to text fields and textarea, and roundness beyond the 6px status dot belongs only to the printed card artwork.

rules.name: The Localized Artifact Rule
rules.body: Switching language redraws the printed card from the same string table as the studio — masthead, issue line, TO/КОМУ and FROM/ОТ labels, message placeholder, stamp text and status words all follow the active language. The GREETING / ПРИВЕТСТВИЕ label remains a studio form label only; the card prints no such caption, in either language.

dos: **Do** keep the preview and the PNG the same surface: draw once at 2× into the 2400×1500 canvas and export that canvas with `toBlob` / `toDataURL`.
**Do** keep every label at 4.5:1 or better; the shipped floor is 4.76:1 and signal red is 6.14–7.03:1 on the dark surfaces.
**Do** use the documented signal alpha ramp (0.05, 0.08, 0.14, 0.25, 0.30) and the deep-red 0.10 wash rather than introducing a new red.

**Do** keep English and Russian at parity: labels, placeholders, ARIA text, card inscriptions, status words and six index-aligned samples move together on a language switch, and the choice persists across reloads.
**Do** keep the scene timer at seven seconds and restart it on every field edit; reduced motion still rotates the scene but skips the fade.
**Do** use 1px structural rules, 0px corners on panels, tiles and buttons, the 2px `--radius` only on text fields, and the 4×2 stamp grid with 60×72px thumbnails.
**Do** keep the authored-demo disclosure and the local-only notice in the footer; the samples and stamp art are demonstration content.
donts: **Don't** screenshot the page or rebuild the card in a second renderer when downloading; the canvas is the artifact.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or leave printed card labels in the other language after a switch.
**Don't** let a label drop below 4.5:1 to make the interface quieter.
**Don't** round the panels, tiles, buttons or language switch, or add a second accent hue; amber is the warning only.
**Don't** present the sample copy as real correspondence or imply the card is uploaded anywhere.
